verdict.rationale: Mercury documents per-card spend limits in its marketing and through the Cards API ('manage spending limits'). A long-time customer independently corroborates creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. The 'granular controls for each employee' half rests only on marketing lines ('spend controls, and granular user permissions'), with no documented detail on what those controls are or how they are assigned to individual employees. missing for 10: documentation of specific per-card control types (e.g. merchant/category restrictions, limit periods), documented per-employee card assignment and controls, independent corroboration of granular employee-level controls.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set per-card spend limits and granular controls for each employee

citations.quote: Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions.
